notes.title: Summer Sale
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43648305/7e76238c30cf3fbf627bb14cac04d6041d19f176.png[/img]

The Voice from the Well is 50% off during the Steam Summer Sale! If you're looking for a fun fantasy adventure with a dash of cosmic horror, join Jay as he finds himself in the land of Velessar. A fully voiced cast brings the first half of this book adaptation to life like never before. Extra choices add new insights into the story.

notes.content: One updated graphical asset was added to the game.
